chunks: "May Allah curse those who cut off the path of kindness."
It was said: "Who are those who cut off the path of kindness?"
He said: "A man is shown kindness, then he is ungrateful for it, so he prevents its doer from doing that to others."

key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ: recognized goodness, kindness, or beneficent conduct
key_terms.فَيَكْفُرُهُ: then he is ungrateful for it or denies it
key_terms.فَيَمْنَعُ: thus he causes prevention or discouragement
key_terms.قَاطِعِي: those who cut off or obstruct
key_terms.لَعَنَ: invoked divine curse upon; a severe condemnation

ai.seo_question: Who are those that block the path of kindness according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns ingratitude toward acts of kindness because it discourages benefactors from continuing to do good. It teaches that failing to acknowledge goodness harms not only oneself but also the wider community by cutting off the spread of benevolence.
